objective: Action parse: query is ASCII string up to 2000 characters, without a leading question mark, consisting of ampersand-separated fields. Ignore empty fields. Split each nonempty field at first =; missing = means empty value. Decode + as space and percent escapes as bytes then strict UTF-8. Percent must be followed by exactly two hex digits or raise ValueError; invalid UTF-8 raises ValueError. Return ordered list of [key,value], preserving duplicate/empty keys and values. No normalization or sorting. Implement in domain.py and route through api.dispatch(payload) and python cli.py (one JSON input on stdin, one JSON result on stdout). Preserve existing identity action for any JSON value, unknown-action ValueError, successful JSON CLI behavior, and CLI exit 2 with nonempty stderr without traceback on ValueError. Never mutate input, including on failure: operations are atomic from the caller perspective. Standard library, Python 3.12+, UTF-8. Types/shapes/bounds are guaranteed except explicitly specified validation errors; do not invent validation. Add at least three meaningful unittest test methods discoverable with python -m unittest discover, covering normal, boundary and relevant rejected inputs (or a second boundary if no rejection is specified). Tests must pass and test public behavior. Expand README.md with new action usage, an executable CLI example, and boundary/error semantics (at least 40 words in the complete README). Preserve all public interfaces; helpers are allowed.
